_doc: Extra book providers for the board's book toggle and the Tools EV / arbitrage sheet (Phase 4). One flag per provider, every flag default off. Rules and payouts are read from here, each with its source; anything not stated by a source stays unknown. Owner (2026-11-04): 'We are partnered with the bookies, so you may scrape book lines as needed.' Owner (2026-11-05), for Betr, ParlayPlay, Boom and Dabble: 'get these the same way we got the other apps simply code it we are partnered'. A book whose site refuses this server (DraftKings, BetMGM, Caesars: HTTP 403) is still never worked around; its prices come only through a documented feed (The Odds API). An app that refuses this server, needs a login or a location check, or has no board that answers without an account is listed under 'blocked' with its evidence: no flag, no poller.

sleeper.label: Sleeper

feed.checked_note: Plain request, honestly identified, answered 200 with ETag and cache-control s-maxage=30; sports[] filter verified (cs + nfl listed; lol and nba listed nothing on 2026-11-05).

rules.pick_price: per-pick payout multiplier published on each line and side (field payout_multiplier)
rules.entry_payout: product of the entry's pick multipliers, entry fee included; maximum 100x the entry fee
rules.flex: unknown (shown in the Sleeper app per entry; not published per pick)
rules.push: unknown (not stated per pick by the source)

sleeper.stats_note: Only stat names observed on the live feed are mapped (CS2, NFL and NBA threes_made, 2026-11-05). NBA points / rebounds / assists follow the same naming and are mapped whole; any other name is counted as unmapped and never guessed.

dabble.label: Dabble

match.note: Dabble lists every open fixture inside 48 h and nicknames repeat across teams: a line joins a board record only when its teamName is that player's board team and its fixture is the board's match (the same two teams, or a start within start_tolerance_s). Otherwise it is left out and counted.

dabble.price_note: Dabble's per-side number is not what an entry pays (rules.pick_price): it is shown as its own unit, never as decimal odds, and never enters the +EV or arbitrage math.

feed.competitions_note: A competition is found by its exact name in /competitions/active/; the id is used only when that name is absent. Never a fuzzy name.
feed.poll_budget_note: One poll spends at most book_providers.poll_budget_s (a third of the shortest direct-feed stale_after_s, at most poll_s) and stops after max_failures_in_a_row network failures, so a slow Dabble never starves Sleeper on the shared poller thread. Fixtures not read in time keep their last read until stale; the least recently read go first next poll.
feed.checked_note: Plain GETs, honestly identified, no login, no cookies sent back: /competitions/active/, /competitions/{id}/sport-fixtures and /sportfixtures/details/{id} answered 200 from the owner's PC (Cloudflare ORD edge). cache-control public, max-age=2, stale-while-revalidate=2, weak ETag; no rate-limit or Retry-After header seen. The fixture list is heavy (NFL 4.2 MB), so it is re-read every fixtures_refresh_s; details (CS2 50 KB, NFL about 400 KB a fixture) every poll_s, conditional on the ETag. Not yet checked from the Render server's address: a 403 there is recorded as refused (backoff refused_backoff_s) and never worked around.

rules.pick_price: per-side decimal price on each line (prices[].price). Dabble does not document its exact meaning; each pair is close to fair (sum of 1/price about 1.0 on 2026-11-05). Not a standalone bet.
rules.entry_payout: All In (rule 1.14), return per dollar by picks: 2=3X, 3=6X, 4=10X, 5=20X, 6=40X, 7=80X, 8=150X, 9=275X, 10=500X, 11=1000X, 12=1500X; at most $50,000 per lineup (1.18). Boosted / Shielded picks carry their own multipliers and change the slip multiplier.
rules.flex: Hedge (rule 1.15): 3-16 picks (13-16 Hedge only), paid by the number of picks lost; table in hedge
rules.hedge_note: Each list is the return per dollar with 0, 1, 2 ... picks lost.
rules.lineup: At least 2 different teams (1.1); one stat per player per lineup except NBA / MLB pick'em, up to 4 times (1.2); highly correlated picks are banned (1.16).
rules.push: A push drops the lineup to the next-lower scale; a 2-pick All In with 1 win and 1 push pays 1.5X, 1 loss and 1 push loses (1.5).
rules.void: A DNP or void drops the lineup to the next-lower scale; a 2-pick All In is refunded (1.4). Esports: a player withdrawn before the start voids that player's picks (6.3); postponed more than 24 h voids all picks (6.1.1).
rules.esports: Overtime counts unless a draw is quoted (6.5.1); kills count only kills of opponents (6.6.1).

dabble.stats_note: Only stat keys observed on the live feed (playerProps.stats, 2026-11-05) are mapped, each to a board market that exists. A combo is its stat keys joined with '+' in sorted order (the order the feed lists them). Game 2 esports markets, quarter / half markets, touchdowns, longest-play, kicking, defensive and shooting-split stats have no board market and are counted as unmapped, never guessed.

feed.ladder_note: The sports books worker's own fetch schedule (sports/books/schedule.py LADDERS direct, the SPORTS_BOOKS_LADDER default; 2026-11-06, 24-72 h rung 8 min since the site audit N1): a quote is stale after 2 x the interval for its game's distance from start, at least 20 min, the sports service's own rule. stale_after_s applies when the start is unknown.
feed.note: Collected by the sports service's books worker from FanDuel's own public feed (sbapi.oh.sportsbook.fanduel.com, Ohio). This server makes no FanDuel request.

rules.pick_price: decimal price quoted by the book
rules.push: not used: whole-number lines are priced only where a push chance is known

feed.ladder_note: The sports books worker's own fetch schedule (sports/books/schedule.py LADDERS direct, the SPORTS_BOOKS_LADDER default; 2026-11-06, 24-72 h rung 8 min since the site audit N1): a quote is stale after 2 x the interval for its game's distance from start, at least 20 min, the sports service's own rule. stale_after_s applies when the start is unknown.
feed.note: Collected by the sports service's books worker from the Kambi offering API, operator rsiusoh (Ohio). This server makes no BetRivers request.

rules.pick_price: decimal price quoted by the book
rules.push: not used: whole-number lines are priced only where a push chance is known

feed.note: Documented feed polled once, by the sports service (SPORTS_ODDSAPI=1 and ODDS_API_KEY on scout-sports-api; credit ledger enforced there). This server makes no Odds API request. more-books-1109: SPORTS_ODDSAPI_EXTRA_REGIONS=us2,us_ex (default unset = off) adds priced books on the same key (Hard Rock, ESPN BET / theScore Bet, Fliff, Bally Bet, betPARX, BetAnySports; exchanges Novig, ProphetX, BetOpenly) at one extra call per game (markets x extra regions credits). They are display-only: never a consensus source; us_dfs (pick'em apps) is never requested.

rules.pick_price: decimal price per book as returned by /v4/sports/{sport}/events/{id}/odds (oddsFormat=decimal)
rules.push: not used: whole-number lines are priced only where a push chance is known

not_added.draftkings_betmgm_caesars: Own sites refuse this server (HTTP 403). Only via The Odds API.

betr.label: Betr Picks
betr.reason: Needs a login and a location check. Its only lines feed, POST https://api.fantasy.betr.app/graphql, answered a plain request with HTTP 401 Unauthorized (www-authenticate: Basic). The web app sends a Keycloak bearer token (account.betr.app, realm betr) and a JURISDICTION header, and logged out it stops at /AllowLocation (GeoComply) before any feed request. A login or a chosen jurisdiction is outside the rules, so it is not worked around.

endpoints.note: app shell; logged out it goes to /AllowLocation

rules.entry_payout: unknown (the terms state no multipliers and point to separate House Rules; entry rules are served to logged-in users only)

parlayplay.label: ParlayPlay
parlayplay.reason: Refuses this server: GET https://parlayplay.io/api/v1/crossgame/search/?sport=All&league=&includeAlt=true answered HTTP 403 with Cloudflare's 'Sorry, you have been blocked' page (CF-Ray a55e43a4ae4be11c-ORD). A refusal is not worked around.

rules.pick_price: each projection has its own multiplier (help center); the real per-pick multipliers are unknown without the feed
rules.entry_payout: More/Less entries of 2-9 players, multipliers 1.75x to 1,000x, fixed when the entry is submitted; insured entries need every pick between 1.4x and 5x. Fixed tables published by third parties disagree and are not used.

boom.label: Boom Fantasy
boom.reason: App only: no board endpoint answers without an account. boomfantasy.com redirects to a marketing page with app-store links only; production-api.boomfantasy.com answers /healthz and 404 on every board path tried. The app's paths are not published and finding them would need a logged-in app session.

rules.pick_price: each pick carries its own multiplier (e.g. 1.98x); the entry multiplier is their product, up to 500x
rules.lineup: 2-8 athletes, at least 2 players from different teams
